title: Declarations to be made with regard to the number of usable sheets to be stated.

checks.requirement: Evaluate the package or inspection data against the legal requirement preserved in source_text.

source_text:
16. Declarations to be made with regard to the number of usable sheets to be stated.-
In the case of a package containing sheets like aluminum foil, facial tissues, waxed paper,
toilet paper or any other type of sheet, the declaration of quantity on the package shall
also include a statement as to the number of usable sheets contained in the package and
the dimensions of each such sheet.
